Axospro.note: Axospro is the North American brand of Jiangmen Gongly Machinery Co., Ltd. and operates independently.

Cattabriga.note: Cattabriga was acquired by competitor Carpigiani in 1970 and later became part of the Ali Group in 1989.

Dolphin Appliances.note: Dolphin Appliances is an independent manufacturer of food and beverage machinery based in India.

Frostiq Pty Ltd.note: Frostiq Pty Ltd operates independently as an Australian supplier of commercial soft serve and slushie machines.

Guangdong Hommy Co., Ltd..note: Guangdong Hommy Co., Ltd. operates independently as a professional manufacturer of ice cream and vending machines.

Guangzhou Protaylor Co., Ltd..note: Guangzhou Protaylor Co., Ltd. is an independent manufacturer specializing in commercial refrigeration equipment.

Huaxin.note: Huaxin operates independently as a global manufacturer of intelligent ice cream vending machines.

Jiangmen Goshen Equipment Co., Ltd..note: No verifiable records exist of an acquisition or independent operations under this exact corporate name; Goshen is a soft-serve machine brand manufactured by Guangzhou Guangshen Electric Produce Co., Ltd.

LUMEN GmbH.note: LUMEN GmbH was founded in 1962 as a subsidiary of the IREKS Group and continues to operate under it.

Ningbo Hicon International Co., Ltd..note: Ningbo Hicon International Co., Ltd. operates independently under the Hicon Industry umbrella.

Real Beverage.note: Real Beverage remains an independent manufacturer of soda and beverage machines founded by Altamas Dhupelwala.

Shenzhen Etang Electric Co., Ltd.note: Shenzhen Etang Electric Co., Ltd continues to operate independently as a manufacturer of refrigeration and ice cream machinery.

Taizhou Summerstar Refrigeration Co., Lt.note: Taizhou Summerstar Refrigeration Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Zhejiang Huangyan Chaoba Electrical Co., Ltd. but was not independently acquired.

Ugolini S.p.A..note: Calao Finance invested in and acquired Groupe Ugolini on September 1, 2024, with the founding families retaining a minority stake.

Zhejiang Creato Machinery Co., Ltd..note: Zhejiang Creato Machinery Co., Ltd. operates independently under the Creato brand specializing in food processing and ice cream machines.
